question: Which warehouse should handle the Vega recall after the final update?

documents.title: beam-10m-early-ops
documents.text: Early operating notes assigned the Vega recall to South Yard. This assignment was temporary.

documents.title: beam-10m-final-update
documents.text: Final update: the Vega recall must be handled by North Pier. North Pier overrides South Yard for all current recall routing.

question: What is the maximum payload capacity of the Falcon drone?

documents.title: beam-10m-falcon-spec
documents.text: The Falcon drone is certified for commercial delivery. Its maximum payload capacity is 12kg per mission.

documents.title: beam-10m-falcon-ops
documents.text: Falcon drones are deployed at hub stations. Each unit carries cargo up to its 12kg limit.

question: Which event happened first: the server migration or the firewall upgrade?

documents.title: beam-10m-ops-log-q1
documents.text: Q1 operations: the server migration was completed in January. All services moved to the new cluster.

documents.title: beam-10m-ops-log-q2
documents.text: Q2 operations: the firewall upgrade was completed in April, three months after the server migration.

question: What is the current SLA for Priority-1 tickets after the policy revision?

documents.title: beam-10m-sla-v1
documents.text: Original SLA policy: Priority-1 tickets must be resolved within 4 hours. This policy was in effect until the Q3 revision.

documents.title: beam-10m-sla-v2
documents.text: Revised SLA policy effective Q3: Priority-1 tickets must be resolved within 2 hours. The old 4-hour target is superseded.

question: Which team owns the service that stores customer payment records?

documents.title: beam-10m-service-registry
documents.text: The Vault service stores all customer payment records and PII. It requires SOC-2 compliance auditing annually.

documents.title: beam-10m-team-ownership
documents.text: The Payments Platform team owns the Vault service. They are responsible for its uptime and compliance.
